Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i. Only Class-I and Class-II Local Suppliers are allowed to participate. Purchase prefe rence shall be given to Class-I local supplier as per Public Procurement (Preference To Make In India), Order 2017 Dated 19.07.2024 issued by DPIIT and it’s subsequent amendments. ii. Only negative tolerance allowed on ID. Applicable quantity tolerance is +25%. iii. BHEL reserves the right, at bid / contract stage, to inspect raw materials and finis hed products, and to verify the bidders manufacturing capability and quality assuran ce systems to ensure compliance with tender requirements iv. PQR as enclosed shall be applicable for technical qualification of the bidders. v. Offer of bidders, who are under Interim Suspension/Debarred in BHEL Corporate le vel or BHEL Bhopal, shall not be entertained and rejected. vi. Required delivery is –24 weeks from PO date. 2 weeks additional can be accept able. Offer of bidders quoting delivery beyond that can be rejected. vii. For items under GeM bid, applicable GST rate is 18% and Cess (cess 1/ cess 2) is 0 % (zero) for GST registered bidder/supplier. As cess is not applicable, offer of bidder quoting cess other than zero is liable to be rejected at any stage of bid even after pri ce bid opening viii. Item shall be accepted on COC basis as per applicable MTC. ix. Payment terms as- 100% payment within 90 days (45 days for MSE & 60 days for Medium enterprise) of receipt of material subject to acceptance of material at BHEL. x. In respect of procurement of goods or services from Micro, Small and M edium enterprises (MSMEs), the settlement of invoice shall be only through any of the TReDS platform (i.e RXIL, M1 exchange, lnvoicemart, KReDX, C2FO), a uthorised by the Reserve Bank of India. Such MSME suppliers to select their preferre d TReDS platform before award of contract so that the data is captured in the Order /Contract database of the Unit. They also will have the option to change the TReDS p latform from the drop-down menu on Suvidha portal of BHEL, at the time of invoice submission xi. Wherever the Trade Receivable is accepted by BHEL, the same shall be validated by the Unit on the respective TReDS platform selected by the supplier. The routing o f invoices through the TReDS platform shall not be construed as mandating discounti ng of such invoices and the MSMEs supplier shall have the option to avail or not avai l financing or discounting of its receivables on the TReDS platform. In case discoun ting is not availed by the supplier on TReDS, the trade receivables will be p aid through TReDS as per the payment timelines indicated in the contract xii. Unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, Penalty for late delivery shall be 0.5% of the undelivered portion per week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10% of the undelivered order value owing to delayed delivery. Total u ndelivered order value above shall be item wise, lot wise order value of PO.

xiii. Vendor to submit duly filled, signed and sealed documents as required in technical specification along with bid for compliance xiv. Tax Invoice, Test Certificate and Guarantee Certificate to be uploaded on BHEL Su vidha Portal after supply (www.suvidha.bhel.in) xv. Material to be properly protected in boxes to avoid any transit damage. xvi. Offers of bidders having technical/ commercial deviations, which are not acceptab le to BHEL, shall be rejected before price bid opening. xvii. Warranty shall be up to 18 months from date of receipt of material/ 12 months of commissioning, whichever is earlier. xviii. Breach of Contract, Remedies and Termination- In case of breach of contract, BHEL may resort to recover 10% of the total contract value through various financial reme dies such as security instruments like Performance Bank Guarantee, bills of the supplier, re tention amount etc. with BHEL or opt for legal remedies. Further, levy of liquidated damage s, debarment, termination, de- scoping, short-closure, etc. shall be applied as per provision s of the contract .
